• How do I describe this week?
  • Well, I have been feeling a bit burned out from studying and fitness, as well as reckoning with other some small things over the week. So in an act of kindness to myself I decided to slow down on a few fronts for the week.
  • Opened the week with the annual health-check, and I am pleased to report that I beat my score from last year (not deliberately). This was also a much more pleasant experience than last year: I guess afternoons are less popular?
  • I then proceeded to do my best to undo that high-score over the week’s dinners. It’s OK: This was entirely deliberate and I enjoyed each and every conversation.
  • Discovered an unpatched technique on the way.
  • And got some useful input on a problem.
  • At some point I have developed MJ’s ability to spot therapizable patterns and to point them out in conversation instead of giving reckons, which feels like personal growth?
  • Not content with being poked and prodded during the health-check I went back later for my first ever influenza vaccine. My arm’s still sore in a way that reminds me of secondary school. I hope it worked.
  • Did some performance tuning of imagecdn and it is now purring along more stably than ever: It is very satisfying seeing memory usage finally remain flat.
  • People have been very kind about my post on times channels. I'd like to write more long-form but find it really hard, so kind words mean a lot.
  • Too many exhibits, not enough time.
  • 疲れたけどたくさん宿題あるんだよ。。。
